page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5e.8xlarge is a dedicated virtual instance from the Local SSDs family designed for I/O-intensive and data-heavy applications. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6763P-C processor clocked at 2.9 GHz across 32 dedicated vCPUs. It integrates 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a high memory density of 8.0 GB per vCPU without any hardware GPU accelerators.

A primary architectural characteristic of this server is its integration of 15358 GB of local SSD capacity alongside an 80 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The collocation of expansive local storage with high throughput interfaces minimizes data access latencies relative to purely network-attached configurations. Because benchmark metrics are not currently available for this instance type, performance evaluation rests on the physical resource density, specifically the combination of massive onboard storage, dedicated Intel compute cores, and high interconnect speeds.

Resource allocation presents clear tradeoffs for deployment planning. The 1:8 core-to-memory ratio provides favorable qualitative cost efficiency for systems requiring significant memory footprints and high local disk throughput under a single operating environment. However, the reliance on local SSD capacity requires that workloads implement replication or backup strategies to handle instance-lifecycle events, as local ephemeral storage operates independently of managed persistent disk snapshots. The instance is suited for large relational databases, distributed NoSQL storage clusters, big data search indexes, and caching tiers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5e.8xlarge is a storage and memory-focused virtual machine within the Local SSDs instance family. Running on the KVM hypervisor, it features 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6763P-C processor at 2.9 GHz, coupled with 256.0 GB of RAM to yield an 8.0 GB per core ratio. The instance includes 15358 GB of integrated local SSD storage, eliminating reliance on detached network block volumes for primary storage requirements. Networking capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 80 Gbps, though no complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU accelerators are provisioned. Due to its balanced combination of high-density local disk space, high memory allocation, and dedicated computing capacity, ecs.i5e.8xlarge is tailored for input/output intensive deployments, large-scale database operations, high-throughput search engines, and real-time analytical clusters.
